bivalves text index | photo index Phylum Mollusca

Class Bivalvia Scintilla clam
Family Galeommatidaeupdated May 2020

Where seen? This tiny clam can move like snails, crawling on a foot holding the shell on its back. It is found under stones, often several together, on many of our shores. Features: 1-2cm. Shell oval, thin and white. The mantle sometimes covers the entire valves. When submerged, little finger-like structures appear from the mantle. Some have a wide ‘foot’ created from fused mantle edges. The foot holds on to a hard surface as well as to slowly creep about or ‘jump’ around quickly.
Sisters Island, Feb 06
Wide ‘foot’ created from mantle edges. Terumbu Semakau, Jun 12 Cyrene Reef, Jun 12 Sembawang, Dec 09Photo shared by Loh Kok Sheng on flickr. Terumbu Bukom, Nov 10Photo shared by Loh Kok Sheng on his blog.
